literal_meaning: হালকা ও ফুরফুরানো শব্দের অনুকরণ (onomatopoeic for light fluttering)
figurative_meaning_en: pleasant, gentle and mild movement, light, airy
example_sentences_in_english: Today's breeze feels delightfully light and airy.
Her mood has become pleasantly light-hearted.
note: This idiom is often used in poetic and everyday Bengali to evoke a sense of lightness and pleasure in natural elements.
